policy: Calibrate each class and material subtype independently. A pooled score cannot authorize a cheaper configuration for an untested class.
holdout_policy: Freeze configurations, rubrics, budgets, and references before exposing fresh local instances to tested models. Reserve an untouched confirmation set after pilot changes.

tracks.fresh_cases: New private briefs with new constraints, segment evidence, competing proposals, and explicit user priorities.
tracks.reference: Before model runs, a domain owner marks acceptable choices, binding violations, and unresolved value choices under a frozen rubric.
objective_checks: claims grounded in the supplied evidence
human_checks: whether a value choice needs the user
tracks.status: requires fresh briefs and human reference labels

tracks.fresh_cases: New private combinations of dependencies, load, provider capabilities, failure traces, and recovery alternatives.
tracks.reference: Executable invariants or model checking for the controlled fragment; independent engineering review for open-ended architecture.
tracks.status: finite scheduling diagnostic implemented; open-ended track requires independent reference

tracks.fresh_cases: New private specifications and candidate implementations, with generated counterexamples and unseen input combinations.
tracks.reference: Hidden behavioral tests plus an engineering rubric fixed before the tested models see candidates.
tracks.status: requires fresh candidate code, hidden tests, and design reference labels

tracks.fresh_cases: New private situations and response alternatives written after the rubric and configurations are frozen.
tracks.reference: Blind human judgments against the user's approved voice examples and fixed rating anchors; allow several acceptable responses.
tracks.status: requires voice rubric approval and blind human reference judgments

tracks.fresh_cases: New private event records or new observed events with frozen authoritative source snapshots, conflicting revisions, and explicit unknowns.
tracks.reference: Programmatic answers for generated records; authoritative source records for real events. Ground each determinant claim and abstention.
human_checks: whether real-world sources settle the question
tracks.status: requires a separate fact-record generator or newly captured authoritative records

shared_metrics: total known cost and unmeasured cost
human_rating_controls: reference labels sealed before tested model runs
anonymized arm identities and randomized answer order
an evaluation model cannot be the sole truth reference for the models being tested
comparison_policy: Compare cost among configurations meeting the same class-specific quality target and coverage floor. Repetitions of the same case are not new independent evidence. Unvalidated classes retain provisional selections.
